"""Core logic for the Strands word-segmentation puzzle."""

import random


class Strand:
    """A single fragment of text that can be merged with others."""

    def __init__(self, text, strand_id):
        self.text = text
        self.strand_id = strand_id
        self.used = False

    def __str__(self):
        return self.text


class Puzzle:
    """A Strands puzzle: merge text strands to form target words/phrases."""

    def __init__(self, title, targets, hint=None):
        self.title = title
        self.targets = [t.upper() for t in targets]
        self.hint = hint
        self.solved = set()
        self.strands = []
        self._build_strands(targets)
        self._shuffle()

    def _build_strands(self, targets):
        pieces = []
        for target in targets:
            pieces.extend(self._split_target(target))
        for i, piece in enumerate(pieces):
            self.strands.append(Strand(piece.upper(), i))

    @staticmethod
    def _split_target(target):
        """Split a target phrase into 2-3 balanced strands."""
        words = target.split()
        if len(words) >= 2:
            # split between words, balancing lengths
            best = None
            for cut in range(1, len(words)):
                left = " ".join(words[:cut])
                right = " ".join(words[cut:])
                diff = abs(len(left) - len(right))
                if best is None or diff < best[0]:
                    best = (diff, [left, right])
            return best[1]
        word = target.replace(" ", "")
        # split single word into two strands near the middle
        mid = (len(word) + 1) // 2
        if len(word) < 4:
            return [word]
        return [word[:mid], word[mid:]]

    def _shuffle(self):
        random.shuffle(self.strands)

    @property
    def available_strands(self):
        return [s for s in self.strands if not s.used]

    def is_complete(self):
        return len(self.solved) == len(self.targets)

    def try_merge(self, indices):
        """Attempt to merge strands (1-based indices into available list).

        Returns (success, message, merged_text).
        """
        available = self.available_strands
        chosen = []
        for idx in indices:
            if not 1 <= idx <= len(available):
                return False, f"Index {idx} is out of range.", None
            chosen.append(available[idx - 1])
        if len(set(id(s) for s in chosen)) != len(chosen):
            return False, "Each strand may be used only once per merge.", None
        merged = "".join(s.text for s in chosen)
        if merged in self.solved:
            return False, f"'{merged}' was already solved.", None
        if merged in self.targets:
            for s in chosen:
                s.used = True
            self.solved.add(merged)
            remaining = len(self.targets) - len(self.solved)
            msg = f"Valid merge! '{merged}' locked in."
            if remaining:
                msg += f" {remaining} target(s) remain."
            else:
                msg += " Puzzle complete!"
            return True, msg, merged
        # feedback: partial matches
        feedback = self._feedback(merged)
        return False, feedback, merged

    def _feedback(self, merged):
        for target in self.targets:
            if target in self.solved:
                continue
            if target.startswith(merged):
                return f"'{merged}' is a promising start of an unsolved target, but not complete yet."
            if merged in target:
                return f"'{merged}' appears inside an unsolved target — try adding strands."
        return f"'{merged}' is not a valid merge. Strands returned to the pool."

        lines = [f"== {self.title} ==", "Available strands:"]
